label: Brighter Clear
difference_from_d: A slightly brighter, clearer presence while preserving D's intimacy, gentleness and unhurried rhythm.

parameters.voice_description: An original English-speaking mascot voice for Merc, an ageless liquid-metal adventure sprite who reads as a young adult. Soft and androgynous with a clear intimate light-mid register, gentle warmth, a slightly brighter presence, quiet wonder and an easy unhurried rhythm. Lightly melodic and whimsical while remaining natural, intelligible and emotionally present. Extra-clear crisp articulation for short game dialogue. Dry, close-mic studio recording with excellent audio quality; no music, background sound or reverb. Moderate-to-soft conversational volume, never shouting. A friendly encouraging coach, never sharp, breathless, wispy, sleepy, childish, squeaky, shrill, announcer-like or imitative.
